data.one_liner: Customizable drop shadow widget for any child
data.what_it_does: SimpleShadow wraps a child widget and draws a customizable shadow behind it. It exposes opacity, color, offset and sigma parameters to fine‑tune the effect.
use_when: You need a drop shadow that differs from the default BoxShadow.
You want to apply a shadow to any widget without writing custom painter code.
You want a quick, declarative way to add visual depth to UI elements.
avoid_when: Performance is critical and you need to avoid extra paint layers.
You require complex, animated shadows that change over time.
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single line of code.
